prompt: Compose a COMPLETE original 30-second instrumental micro-score for a short product promotional video. Exactly one short cue, not a full-length song. Sound: tactile acoustic minimalism; interlocking wooden percussion and witty plucked melody. Instruments: woodblocks, pizzicato strings, marimba, brushed snare. Tempo 120 BPM, 4/4. Main hook: a falling three-note figure. [00:00] Immediate confident musical hook and beat within the first half-second, no intro or fade-in. [00:02] Establish a catchy clear groove with space for visual edits. [00:16] One crisp stop-and-restart or timbral switch, then a slightly fuller reprise. [00:26] A concise resolving fill. [00:29] A decisive final musical button for a logo reveal. [00:30] End completely after the brief natural decay. Total duration 30 seconds. Maintain the hook throughout, usable from any downbeat. Punchy but not harsh, audible melody and rhythm on phone speakers, controlled sub-bass, no long riser, no slow build or repeated sections. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An upbeat and playful instrumental track featuring a bright, staccato synth melody over a light, driving rhythm section. The arrangement includes pizzicato-like synth strings and a simple, cheerful woodwind-like counter-melody.
description.zh: 一首欢快活泼的纯音乐曲目，以明亮、断奏的合成器旋律为主，配以轻快、有推动力的节奏部分。编曲中包含拨弦效果的合成器弦乐和简单愉悦的木管乐器般的对位旋律。
